<!-- checkout-redesign:start -->
<style id="checkout-redesign">
/* Checkout redesign (address cards + step actions) — scoped to .checkout-page.
   Note: never write a dot followed by two underscores in this file; Frappe rejects such templates. */
.checkout-page {
    --co-navy: #262C66;
    --co-navy-dark: #1b2050;
    --co-ink: #1e293b;
    --co-muted: #64748b;
    --co-line: #e2e8f0;
    --co-line-strong: #cbd5e1;
    --co-surface: #f4f6fa;
    --co-radius: 12px;
}

/* ---------- Section titles ---------- */
.checkout-page .co-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 28px; color: var(--co-ink); }

/* ---------- Address list ---------- */
.checkout-page .co-addr-list {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));
    gap: 14px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: visible;
}

/* ---------- Address card ---------- */
.checkout-page .co-addr {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: stretch;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 18px;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--co-line);
    border-radius: 14px;
    box-shadow: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: border-color .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease, background-color .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
}
.checkout-page .co-addr:hover {
    border-color: rgba(38, 44, 102, .4);
    box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -18px rgba(38, 44, 102, .4);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}
.checkout-page .co-addr:has(input:checked) {
    background: rgba(38, 44, 102, .04);
    border-color: var(--co-navy);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(38, 44, 102, .12);
    transform: none;
}
.checkout-page .co-addr:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid var(--co-navy); outline-offset: 3px; }

/* selection indicator (drawn on the card; the real radio covers the card so the whole card is clickable) */
.checkout-page .co-addr::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 18px;
    right: 18px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
    background: #fff;
    border: 2px solid var(--co-line-strong);
    border-radius: 50%;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: border-color .15s ease, background-color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease;
}
.checkout-page .co-addr:hover::after { border-color: var(--co-navy); }
.checkout-page .co-addr:has(input:checked)::after {
    background: var(--co-navy);
    border-color: var(--co-navy);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px #fff;
}
.checkout-page .co-addr input[type="radio"],
.checkout-page .co-addr input.billing-radio,
.checkout-page .co-addr input.shipping-radio {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 2;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    appearance: none;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
}

/* ---------- Card body: pin + lines, phone ---------- */
.checkout-page .co-addr__body { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; padding: 0; background: transparent; border: 0; }
.checkout-page .co-addr__body,
.checkout-page .co-addr__body section {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    overflow: visible;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}
.checkout-page .co-addr__body section { padding: 0; background: transparent; border: 0; }
.checkout-page .co-addr__body section > section { flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: nowrap; justify-content: flex-start; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; }

.checkout-page .co-addr__body section > section:first-child > img {
    flex: 0 0 38px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;
    padding: 10px;
    object-fit: contain;
    background: rgba(38, 44, 102, .08);
    border-radius: 50%;
    filter: brightness(0) saturate(100%) invert(14%) sepia(45%) saturate(2400%) hue-rotate(228deg) brightness(92%);
}
.checkout-page .co-addr__body section > section:first-child > div {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    flex: 1 1 0;
    gap: 2px;
    min-width: 0;
    width: auto;
    padding: 1px 32px 0 0;
}
.checkout-page .co-addr__body section > section:first-child > div > div {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 21px;
    color: #475569;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.checkout-page .co-addr__body section > section:first-child > div > div:nth-child(1) { order: 1; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--co-ink); }
.checkout-page .co-addr__body section > section:first-child > div > div:nth-child(2) { order: 2; }
.checkout-page .co-addr__body section > section:first-child > div > div:nth-child(3) { order: 3; }
.checkout-page .co-addr__body section > section:first-child > div > div:nth-child(5) { order: 4; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .02em; }
.checkout-page .co-addr__body section > section:first-child > div > div:nth-child(4) { order: 5; color: var(--co-muted); }
.checkout-page .co-addr__body section > section:first-child > div > div:empty { display: none; }

.checkout-page .co-addr__body section > section:last-child {
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding-top: 12px;
    border-top: 1px dashed var(--co-line-strong);
}
.checkout-page .co-addr__body section > section:last-child > img {
    flex: 0 0 16px;
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    object-fit: contain;
    filter: brightness(0) saturate(100%) invert(14%) sepia(45%) saturate(2400%) hue-rotate(228deg) brightness(92%);
}
.checkout-page .co-addr__body section > section:last-child > div {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background: transparent;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 20px;
    color: var(--co-ink);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.checkout-page .co-addr__body section > section:last-child:not(:has(div:not(:empty))) { display: none; }

/* ---------- Add new address ---------- */
.checkout-page .co-addr-add {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    height: 54px;
    padding: 0 16px;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--co-navy);
    background: transparent;
    border: 1.5px dashed rgba(38, 44, 102, .4);
    border-radius: 14px;
    box-shadow: none;
    transition: background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
}
.checkout-page .co-addr-add::before { content: "+"; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; }
.checkout-page .co-addr-add p, .checkout-page .co-addr-add div { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: inherit; }
.checkout-page .co-addr-add:hover { background: rgba(38, 44, 102, .05); border-color: var(--co-navy); }
.checkout-page .co-addr-add:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--co-navy); outline-offset: 2px; }

/* ---------- Step actions ---------- */
.checkout-page .co-actions { display: flex; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; }
.checkout-page .co-deliver { display: flex; flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: auto; }
.checkout-page .co-deliver input { flex: 0 0 20px; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--co-navy); cursor: pointer; }
.checkout-page .co-deliver p, .checkout-page .co-deliver div { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--co-ink); }

.checkout-page .co-next,
.checkout-page .co-prev {
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    width: auto;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
    height: 48px;
    padding: 0 26px;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-radius: var(--co-radius);
    box-shadow: none;
    transition: background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease;
}
.checkout-page .co-next { color: #fff; background: var(--co-navy); border: 1px solid var(--co-navy); }
.checkout-page .co-next::after { content: "\2192"; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1; transition: transform .15s ease; }
.checkout-page .co-next:hover { background: var(--co-navy-dark); border-color: var(--co-navy-dark); }
.checkout-page .co-next:hover::after { transform: translateX(3px); }
.checkout-page .co-prev { color: var(--co-navy); background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--co-line-strong); }
.checkout-page .co-prev::before { content: "\2190"; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1; }
.checkout-page .co-prev:hover { background: var(--co-surface); border-color: #94a3b8; }
.checkout-page .co-next > *, .checkout-page .co-prev > * { margin: 0; padding: 0; color: inherit; background: transparent; border: 0; box-shadow: none; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; }
.checkout-page .co-next p, .checkout-page .co-prev p { margin: 0; color: inherit; }
.checkout-page .co-next:focus-visible, .checkout-page .co-prev:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--co-navy); outline-offset: 2px; }


/* ---------- Confirm order: address review cards ---------- */
.checkout-page .co-review-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; width: 100%; padding: 0; }
.checkout-page .co-review {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 14px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 20px;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--co-line);
    border-radius: 14px;
    box-shadow: none;
    transition: border-color .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.checkout-page .co-review:hover { border-color: rgba(38, 44, 102, .35); box-shadow: 0 14px 28px -18px rgba(38, 44, 102, .35); }
.checkout-page .co-review__title {
    align-self: flex-start;
    width: auto;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 3px 10px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 16px;
    letter-spacing: .06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    border-radius: 999px;
}
.checkout-page .co-review__title p { margin: 0; font: inherit; color: inherit; }
.checkout-page .co-review--billing .co-review__title { color: var(--co-navy); background: rgba(38, 44, 102, .08); }
.checkout-page .co-review--shipping .co-review__title { color: #0f766e; background: rgba(15, 118, 110, .1); }

.checkout-page .co-review__body {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 38px minmax(0, 1fr);
    grid-auto-rows: auto;
    column-gap: 12px;
    row-gap: 2px;
    align-items: start;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0;
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
}
.checkout-page .co-review__body::before {
    content: "";
    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: 1 / span 4;
    width: 38px;

        if (!overlay || !form) { overlay = null; return; }
        errorBox = $(".co-auth-error", form);
        submitBtn = $(".co-auth-submit", form);
        overlay.addEventListener("click", function (e) { if (e.target === overlay) closeModal(); });
        $(".co-auth-close", overlay).addEventListener("click", closeModal);
        $(".co-switch-register", overlay).addEventListener("click", function () { closeModal(); focusRegister(); });
        $(".co-show-pw", overlay).addEventListener("change", function () {
            form.elements["co_password"].type = this.checked ? "text" : "password";
        });
        form.addEventListener("submit", submitLogin);
        document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Escape") closeModal(); });
    }

    /* ---------- Panel buttons ---------- */
    function focusRegister() {
        var first = $('#submit-order input[name="first_name"]');
        if (!first) return;
        first.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
        setTimeout(function () { first.focus(); }, 350);
    }
    function bindPanel() {
        var login = $(".co-auth-panel .co-login-open");
        var register = $(".co-auth-panel .co-register-open");
        if (login) login.addEventListener("click", function () { openModal(emailValue()); });
        if (register) register.addEventListener("click", focusRegister);
    }

    /* ---------- Registered email handling ---------- */
    function notice() { return document.getElementById("co-email-notice"); }
    function showAccountExists(email, scroll) {
        var n = notice();
        state.accountExists = true;
        state.email = email;
        if (!n) { openModal(email); return; }
        n.hidden = false;
        if (scroll) n.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
    }
    function clearAccountExists() {
        state.accountExists = false;
        var n = notice();
        if (n) n.hidden = true;
    }
    function checkEmail() {
        var email = emailValue();
        var input = emailInput();
        if (!email || !input || !input.checkValidity()) { clearAccountExists(); return; }

        });
    }
    window.coShowAccountExists = function (email) { showAccountExists(email || emailValue(), true); };

    function bindEmail() {
        var input = emailInput();
        var n = notice();
        if (!input || !n) return;
        var loginBtn = $(".co-notice-login", n);
        if (loginBtn) loginBtn.addEventListener("click", function () { openModal(state.email || emailValue()); });
        input.addEventListener("change", checkEmail);
        input.addEventListener("input", function () { if (state.accountExists && emailValue() !== state.email) clearAccountExists(); });
        if (input.value) checkEmail();

    // A registered email must never reach order placement: stop the step change / submit and show the login prompt.
    function guardSteps() {
        document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
            if (!state.accountExists) return;
            var btn = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest("button") : null;
            var handler = btn && btn.getAttribute("onclick");
            if (handler && /nextTab|showTab\((1|2)\)/.test(handler)) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                showAccountExists(state.email, true);
            }
        }, true);
        var checkout = document.getElementById("submit-order");
        if (checkout) checkout.addEventListener("submit", function (e) {
            if (!state.accountExists) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            showAccountExists(state.email, true);
        }, true);
    }

    function init() {
        bindModal();
        bindPanel();
        bindEmail();
        guardSteps();
    }
    if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
    else init();

user = frappe.session.user user_data = frappe.get_cached_doc("User", user) billing_addresses = [] shipping_addresses = [] if user != "Guest": # Step 1: Find Customer via portal_users child table portal_user_link = frappe.get_all( "Portal User", filters={"user": user}, fields=["parent"] ) if portal_user_link: customer = portal_user_link[0]["parent"] user_logged_in = True user_data = frappe.get_cached_doc("User", user) # Step 2: Get all addresses linked to this customer address_links = frappe.get_all( "Dynamic Link", filters={ "parenttype": "Address", "link_doctype": "Customer", "link_name": customer }, fields=["parent"] ) address_names = [dl["parent"] for dl in address_links] if address_names: # Billing addresses billing_addresses = frappe.get_all( "Address", filters={ "name": ["in", address_names], "address_type": "Billing", "disabled": 0 }, fields=["*"] ) # Shipping addresses shipping_addresses = frappe.get_all( "Address", filters={ "name": ["in", address_names], "address_type": "Shipping", "disabled": 0 }, fields=["*"] ) address_type_options = [{'name':'Billing'}, {'name': "Shipping"}] customers = frappe.get_all( "Customer", filters=[ ["Portal User", "user", "=", user] ], fields=["name", "customer_name"] ) customer_names = [c.name for c in customers] quotations = frappe.get_all( "Quotation", filters={ "party_name": ["in", customer_names] }, fields=["name", "transaction_date", "grand_total", "status", "net_total", "total_taxes_and_charges"] ) orders = [] for quot in quotations: # Check if a Sales Order exists for this quotation so = frappe.get_all( "Sales Order", filters={"custom_quotation_reference": quot["name"]}, fields=["name", "transaction_date", "grand_total", "status", "net_total", "total_taxes_and_charges"], limit=1 ) if so: order = so[0] order["type"] = "Sales Order" orders.append(order) else: quot["type"] = "Quotation" quot["status"] = "Unpaid" if quot["status"] == "Open" else quot["status"] orders.append(quot) standalone_orders = frappe.get_all( "Sales Order", filters={ "customer": ["in", customer_names], "custom_quotation_reference": ["in", ["", None]] }, fields=[ "name", "transaction_date", "grand_total", "status", "net_total", "total_taxes_and_charges" ] ) for so in standalone_orders: so["type"] = "Sales Order" orders.append(so) # Sort by transaction_date orders.sort(key=lambda x: x["transaction_date"], reverse=True) # Order history pagination: 10 per page. Only the current page's orders get their items/taxes loaded below. orders_per_page = 10 orders_total = len(orders) orders_total_pages = max(1, -(-orders_total // orders_per_page)) try: orders_page = int(frappe.form_dict.get("orders_page", 1)) except Exception: orders_page = 1 orders_page = min(max(orders_page, 1), orders_total_pages) orders_start = (orders_page - 1) * orders_per_page orders = orders[orders_start:orders_start + orders_per_page] for order in orders: if order["type"] == "Sales Order": order["order_items"] = frappe.get_all( "Sales Order Item", filters={"parent": order["name"]}, fields=["item_code", "item_name", "qty", "rate", "amount", "image"] ) order["taxes"] = frappe.get_all( "Sales Taxes and Charges", filters={"parent": order["name"]}, fields=["charge_type", "account_head", "rate", "tax_amount", "description"] ) order["pay_url"] = "/api/method/storekit.api.sales_order_payment.get_payment_url?sales_order=" + order["name"] order["show_btn"] = False elif order["type"] == "Quotation": order["order_items"] = frappe.get_all( "Quotation Item", filters={"parent": order["name"]}, fields=["item_code", "item_name", "qty", "rate", "amount", "image"] ) order["taxes"] = frappe.get_all( "Sales Taxes and Charges", filters={"parent": order["name"]}, fields=["charge_type", "account_head", "rate", "tax_amount", "description"] ) order["pay_url"] = "/api/method/storekit.api.sales_order_payment.initiate_quotation_payment?quotation=" + order["name"] order["show_btn"] = True if order["status"] in ["Unpaid"] else False # Format status with color (safe for Frappe Builder) status = order.get("status", "") if status in ["Cancelled", "Draft"]: order["status"] = '

' + status + '

' + status + '

' + status + '

<!-- pdp-redesign:start -->
<style id="pdp-redesign">
/* Product details page redesign — scoped to .pdp. Card styles (related products) come from the shared product-card rules in Builder Settings. */
.pdp {
    --pp-navy: #262C66;
    --pp-navy-dark: #1b2050;
    --pp-ink: #1e293b;
    --pp-muted: #64748b;
    --pp-line: #e2e8f0;
    --pp-line-strong: #cbd5e1;
    --pp-surface: #f4f6fa;
    --pp-radius: 10px;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1320px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    gap: 40px;
    overflow: visible;
}

/* ---------- Main: gallery + info ---------- */
.pdp .pdp-main {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.05fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 48px;
    overflow: visible;
}
.pdp .pdp-gallery {
    aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
    padding: 32px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--pp-line);
    border-radius: 16px;
    box-shadow: none;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.pdp .pdp-gallery img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    max-height: 100%;
    min-height: 0;
    object-fit: contain;
    mix-blend-mode: multiply;
}

.pdp .pdp-info {
    padding: 32px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    gap: 18px;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--pp-line);
    border-radius: 16px;
    box-shadow: none;
}
.pdp .pdp-title {
    font-size: 30px;
    line-height: 38px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--pp-navy);
}

/* category chip + SKU */
.pdp .pdp-info > section:nth-child(2) { gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.pdp .pdp-chip {
    padding: 5px 12px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: .04em;
    color: var(--pp-navy);
    background: rgba(38, 44, 102, .08);
}
.pdp .pdp-sku {
    height: auto;
    padding: 0;
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
}
.pdp .pdp-sku > * { font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; color: var(--pp-muted); }
.pdp .pdp-sku > *::before { content: "SKU: "; }

/* rating */
.pdp .pdp-rating { gap: 10px; }
.pdp .pdp-rating > div:first-child { width: auto; }
.pdp .pdp-rating svg { width: 96px; height: 17px; }
.pdp .pdp-rating > *:last-child { font-size: 14px; color: var(--pp-muted); }

/* price */
.pdp .pdp-price {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 32px;
    line-height: 40px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--pp-ink);
}
.pdp .pdp-price::after { content: "(Exc. VAT)"; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--pp-muted); }

/* quantity + add to cart */
.pdp .pdp-info .cart-qty-update {
    width: 100%;
    gap: 12px;
    align-items: stretch;
    overflow: visible;
}
.pdp .pdp-info .cart-qty-update > div:first-child {
    height: 48px;
    align-items: center;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--pp-line-strong);
    border-radius: var(--pp-radius);
}
.pdp .pdp-info .qty-minus,
.pdp .pdp-info .qty-plus {
    width: 40px;
    height: 46px;
    font-size: 20px;
    color: #475569;
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background-color .15s ease, color .15s ease;
}
.pdp .pdp-info .qty-minus:hover,
.pdp .pdp-info .qty-plus:hover { background: var(--pp-surface); color: var(--pp-navy); }
.pdp .pdp-info .qty-minus p,
.pdp .pdp-info .qty-plus p { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; }
.pdp .pdp-info .item-qty {
    width: 56px;
    height: 46px;
    padding: 0;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--pp-ink);
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
}
.pdp .pdp-info button.add-to-cart-details,
.pdp .pdp-info button.add-variants-cart {
    flex: 1;
    width: auto;
    min-width: 0;
    height: 48px;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 24px;
    border-radius: var(--pp-radius);
    box-shadow: none;
    transition: background-color .15s ease, transform .1s ease;
}
.pdp .pdp-info button.add-to-cart-details { background: var(--pp-navy); border: 0; }
.pdp .pdp-info button.add-to-cart-details:hover { background: var(--pp-navy-dark); }
.pdp .pdp-info button.add-to-cart-details:active { transform: scale(.98); }
.pdp .pdp-info button.add-to-cart-details p,
.pdp .pdp-info button.add-variants-cart p { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }
.pdp .pdp-info button.add-variants-cart {
    color: var(--pp-navy);
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--pp-navy);
}
.pdp .pdp-info button.add-variants-cart:hover { background: var(--pp-surface); }
.pdp .pdp-info button:focus-visible,
.pdp .pdp-reviews button:focus-visible,
.pdp .pdp-reviews a:focus-visible,
.pdp .pdp-description button:focus-visible,
.pdp .pdp-info .cart-qty-update > div:first-child:focus-within {
    outline: 2px solid var(--pp-navy);
    outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* description */
.pdp .pdp-description { margin: 0; padding-top: 20px; gap: 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--pp-line); }
.pdp .pdp-description > *:first-child { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--pp-ink); }
.pdp .pdp-description > *:nth-child(2),
.pdp .pdp-description > *:nth-child(2) * { font-size: 15px; line-height: 24px; color: #475569; opacity: 1; }
.pdp .pdp-description > button {
    padding: 0;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 20px;
    color: var(--pp-navy);
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
}

/* ---------- Reviews ---------- */
.pdp .pdp-reviews {
    overflow: visible;
    gap: 32px;
    padding: 40px;
    background: var(--pp-surface);
    border-radius: 16px;
}
.pdp .pdp-reviews textarea {
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    font-size: 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--pp-line-strong);
    border-radius: var(--pp-radius);
}

<script id="pdp-fbt-script">
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const section = document.querySelector(".pdp-fbt");
    if (!section) return;

    const items = Array.from(section.querySelectorAll(".pdp-fbt__item"));
    const total = section.querySelector(".pdp-fbt__total");
    const button = section.querySelector(".pdp-fbt__add");
    const money = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-GB", { style: "currency", currency: "GBP" });

    const checkbox = (item) => item.querySelector(".pdp-fbt__check");
    const selected = () => items.filter((item) => checkbox(item).checked);

    function buttonLabel(count) {
        if (!count) return "Select an item";
        if (count === 1) return "Add to basket";
        return count === items.length ? "Add all " + count + " to basket" : "Add " + count + " to basket";
    }

    function refresh() {
        const chosen = selected();
        const sum = chosen.reduce((amount, item) => amount + parseFloat(item.dataset.price || 0), 0);
        items.forEach((item) => item.classList.toggle("is-off", !checkbox(item).checked));
        total.textContent = money.format(sum);
        button.textContent = buttonLabel(chosen.length);
        button.disabled = !chosen.length;
    }

    // One at a time: guest carts live in a cookie and logged-in carts in a single Quotation,
    // so parallel requests would overwrite each other.
    async function addItem(itemCode) {
        const response = await fetch("/api/method/storekit.webshop_functions.cart.update_cart", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "x-frappe-csrf-token": frappe.csrf_token,
                "x-requested-with": "XMLHttpRequest",
                Accept: "application/json"
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ item_code: itemCode, qty: 1, cart_items: frappe.get_cookie("cart_items") })
        });
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Cart update failed: " + response.status);
    }

    function showResult(text, background) {
        Toastify({
            text: text,
            close: true,
            gravity: "top",
            position: "center",
            stopOnFocus: true,
            style: { background: background }
        }).showToast();
    }

    function updateBadge() {
        const badge = document.getElementById("cart_count");
        if (badge) badge.innerText = frappe.get_cookie("cart_count") || 0;
    }

    button.addEventListener("click", async function () {
        const chosen = selected();
        let added = 0;
        button.disabled = true;
        button.textContent = "Adding...";
        try {
            for (const item of chosen) {
                await addItem(item.dataset.item_code);
                added += 1;
            }
            showResult(added === 1 ? "Item added to cart!" : added + " items added to cart!", "linear-gradient(to right, #00b09b, #96c93d)");
        } catch (error) {
            console.error("Often purchased together:", error);
            showResult("Added " + added + " of " + chosen.length + " items. Please try again.", "linear-gradient(to right, #ff5f6d, #ffc371)");
        }
        updateBadge();
        refresh();
    });

    items.forEach((item) => checkbox(item).addEventListener("change", refresh));
    refresh();
});
</script>

data.clients = frappe.get_all(
        "Trusted Client",
        fields=["client_name", "logo", "website_url"],
        order_by="creation desc"
    )
data.testimonials = frappe.get_all(
        "Client Testimonial",
        filters={"publish_to_website": 1},
        fields=["person_name", "trusted_client", "description"],
        order_by="creation desc"
    )
case_studies = frappe.get_all(
        "Case Study",
        filters={"published": 1},
        fields=["title", "route", "image", "short_description"],
        order_by="creation desc",
        limit=3
)

for cs in case_studies:
  cs["route"] = "/case-studies/" + cs.get('route')

data.first_cs = case_studies[0]
data.sec_cs = case_studies[1]
data.third_cs = case_studies[2]

case_studies = frappe.get_all(
        "Case Study",
        filters={"published": 1},
        fields=["title", "route", "image", "short_description"],
        order_by="creation desc",
        limit=3
)

for cs in case_studies:
  cs["route"] = "/case-studies/" + cs.get('route')

data.case_studies = case_studies
